Position: Senior Backend Engineer
Company: Global Cloud Platforms
Location: Remote / San Francisco, CA

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our core distributed systems team. You will lead the design and implementation of resilient, high-volume RESTful services, database optimizations, and containerized cloud services.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain high-throughput backend microservices in Java and Spring Boot.
- Optimize relational database queries, schemas, and connection pools in PostgreSQL.
- Build containerized applications using Docker and manage deployments with automated CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
- Collaborate with frontend engineers to build well-documented OpenAPI REST endpoints.
- Champion engineering best practices, code reviews, and comprehensive unit/integration testing.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of production experience developing backend services in Java (Java 17/21).
- Deep knowledge of Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and SQL.
- Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL performance tuning and migrations.
- Solid experience containerizing applications with Docker.
- Experience writing automated tests using JUnit and Mockito.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have:
- AWS certification or practical experience deploying to AWS services.
- Experience with OAuth2 and JWT token validation.
